name: Chain + 0→last residual
tagline: Standard sequential chain plus a single skip edge from the first to the last node so the sink sees both raw and refined solutions.
diff_from_baseline: Same as the chain baseline but with an extra single residual edge $0\to N-1$, giving the sink an unmodified copy of the source draft alongside the deepest refinement; not star (no hub) and not layered.

name: Twin-writer + reviewer + integrator
tagline: For N=4: two parallel writers feed a reviewer who hands off to a single integrator; for $N>4$ falls back to chain plus distance-2 skip edges.
diff_from_baseline: Custom-tunes the $N=4$ case to a layered fan-in-then-chain (different from chain, star, or fully-layered baselines), and only at larger $N$ falls back to chain-plus-skip; never uses a global hub or full bipartite layers.

name: Anchor chain (rooted chain)
tagline: Sequential chain with an additional anchor edge $0\to i$ for every $i\ge 1$, bounding in-degree to 2 while preserving full chain depth.
init_recovers: Chain baseline degenerates when star anchors are removed
diff_from_baseline: Strict superset of the chain baseline (keeps chain edges) and complementary to the star baseline (adds chain edges on top of the hub), bounding sink in-degree at 2 — neither chain nor star alone, and not the fully-bipartite layered baseline.

name: Single-sink review diamond
tagline: $N=4$ uses a diamond: nodes 0,1 explore; node 2 merges; node 3 sees the merge plus the still-unaggregated branch from 1. Larger N adds 2-step skip funnel.
init_recovers: Reduces to chain when all skip edges are dropped
diff_from_baseline: Replaces chain's strict sequence and layered's full bipartite merges with a small diamond pattern at the sink and 2-step skips for deeper graphs; differs from star by not centralizing on a single hub.

name: Chain + early/mid → sink bypasses
tagline: Primary refinement chain $0\to 1\to\dots\to N-1$ plus bypass edges from every intermediate node to the final sink.
diff_from_baseline: Differs from chain by adding bypass edges from each interior node to the sink (final agent sees solution evolution), differs from star by also keeping chain edges, and differs from layered by routing all extra edges into a single sink rather than bipartite layers.
